    OC, OD, OH, OW,
    stride_d, stride_h, stride_w,
    pad_d, pad_h, pad_w,
    groups,
    ic_per_group, oc_per_group,
    num_oc_blocks,
    x_stride_b, x_stride_c, x_stride_d, x_stride_h, x_stride_w,
    w_stride_ic, w_stride_oc, w_stride_kd, w_stride_kh, w_stride_kw,
    out_stride_b, out_stride_c, out_stride_d, out_stride_h, out_stride_w,
    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
    KD: tl.constexpr, KH: tl.constexpr, KW: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_IC: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_W: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_OC: tl.constexpr,

    pid_b = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_gc = tl.program_id(1)
    pid_dh = tl.program_id(2)
    od = pid_dh // OH
    oh = pid_dh % OH
    ow = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_W)
    mask_ow = ow < OW
    g = pid_gc // num_oc_blocks
    oc_block = pid_gc % num_oc_blocks
    ic_start = g * ic_per_group
    ic_off = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_IC)
    mask_ic = ic_off < ic_per_group
    oc_off = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_OC)
    oc_local = oc_block * BLOCK_OC + oc_off
    mask_oc = oc_local < oc_per_group
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_W), dtype=tl.float32)
    for kd in range(KD):
        id_num = od + pad_d - kd
        id_idx = id_num // stride_d
        valid_d = (id_num % stride_d == 0) & (id_idx >= 0) & (id_idx < ID)
        id_idx_c = tl.maximum(tl.minimum(id_idx, ID - 1), 0)

            ih_idx = ih_num // stride_h
            valid_h = (ih_num % stride_h == 0) & (ih_idx >= 0) & (ih_idx < IH)
            ih_idx_c = tl.maximum(tl.minimum(ih_idx, IH - 1), 0)
            valid_dh = valid_d & valid_h

                iw_num = ow + pad_w - kw
                iw_idx = iw_num // stride_w
                valid_w = (iw_num % stride_w == 0) & (iw_idx >= 0) & (iw_idx < IW) & mask_ow
                iw_idx_c = tl.maximum(tl.minimum(iw_idx, IW - 1), 0)
                x_ptrs = (
                    x_ptr
                    + pid_b * x_stride_b
                    + (ic_start + ic_off)[:, None] * x_stride_c
                    + id_idx_c * x_stride_d
                    + ih_idx_c * x_stride_h
                    + iw_idx_c[None, :] * x_stride_w
                )

                x_vals = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=x_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                w_ptrs = (
                    w_ptr
                    + (ic_start + ic_off)[:, None] * w_stride_ic
                    + oc_local[None, :] * w_stride_oc
                    + kd * w_stride_kd
                    + kh * w_stride_kh
                    + kw * w_stride_kw

                w_vals = tl.load(w_ptrs, mask=w_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                acc += tl.dot(tl.trans(w_vals), x_vals)

    if HAS_BIAS:
        bias_val = tl.load(bias_ptr + pid_oc, mask=mask_oc, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        acc = acc + bias_val[:, None]
    out_ptrs = (
        out_ptr
        + pid_b * out_stride_b
        + pid_oc[:, None] * out_stride_c
        + od * out_stride_d
        + oh * out_stride_h
        + ow[None, :] * out_stride_w
    )
    out_mask = mask_oc[:, None] & mask_ow[None, :]
    tl.store(out_ptrs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=out_mask)
